name: Intune Hydration Kit
description: A PowerShell module that automates Microsoft Intune tenant setup by deploying 70+ security baselines, 43 dynamic groups, 24 device filters, compliance policies, app protection policies, and Conditional Access policies in a single command. Integrates OpenIntuneBaseline and supports multi-cloud environments.
keywords: how to configure new intune tenant
author: Jorge Suarez

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall assessment: The codebase appears to be a legitimate Intune hydration tool with standard module structure, Graph API authentication, and build/publish tooling. No obfuscated code or remote code execution detected. Token handling shows a potential plaintext exposure risk when converting access tokens to SecureString for Connect-MgGraph; suppressions exist but recommend safer handling or API-supported approaches. A hardcoded default ClientId is present in the browser-based authentication flow; parameterize or remove defaults to reduce misconfiguration risk. No evidence of data exfiltration beyond Graph API calls, nor any malicious persistence or anti-security patterns.
